content_blocks.steps_heading: Your PMP Certification Path in Lawrenceville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's exact education and hours requirements, then contact Granite PM Academy to verify your profile meets the credential standard.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Lawrenceville-based instructors deliver the PMI-mandated 35 contact hours of formal education. You'll learn project management frameworks, risk, procurement, and exam strategy in real time with peers and expert guidance.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you've finished the boot camp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI. Include proof of your education and project management experience hours. Pay the PMI exam fee at the time of application to secure your seat for the certification exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation support and practice materials to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your exam at a testing center, and sit for the four-hour, 200-question PMP exam. Our instructors remain available to answer final clarifications before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, project work, volunteering, or community service. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to help you sustain your certification and advance your career.
